english.title: Pilot fail to enter required information in the technical log / approved record at end of flight
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the pilot in command of a non-Part-21 aircraft registered in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), for which a certificate of airworthiness was in force and which was a

(A)_[commercial air transport]_
(B)_[public transport]_
(C)_[commercial operation]_

aircraft, failed to enter and sign and date in the technical log or the approved record the times when the aircraft took off and landed, information about any defect which was known to you and which affected the airworthiness or safe operation of the aircraft, or if no such defect was known to you, an entry to that effect and such other information about the airworthiness or operation of the aircraft as the CAA required in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 227(4) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
